title: Spec v2: owner line filled in

blocks.text: Who can change fields in the inspection record, and how both sides find out.
Capulet owns the inspection record schema; Montague owns the routing envelope; any change needs both to approve. Every event carries schema_version.
Decided with Romeo at the 3pm sync. This covers the inspection record and the envelope only, not Balcony's internals or Mesh Routing's.
Field versioning: who owns it, and how do both sides agree to a change? Settle with Romeo at 3.
Export by site: timing. Depends on what Ducal's freight system can take in.
